# `fluxsim calibrate`

Read a Playback's declared scorecard and report the credibility and grade it carries. Declared calibration only: no fitting is performed.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim calibrate [options] <bundle>
```

## Examples

```bash
# print the declared scorecard; nothing is written
fluxsim calibrate ./bundle

# record it in the run directory
fluxsim calibrate ./bundle --write --run-id de72fa4b22711c52
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `bundle` | path to the FLUX bundle directory |

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--playback-id` | `PLAYBACK_ID` | default: the bundle's only Playback |
| `--dry-run` |  | print the scorecard without writing calibration-provenance.json (default) |
| `--write` |  | write calibration-provenance.json into the run directory |
| `--run-id` | `RUN_ID` | required without --dry-run |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
